title: KGARevion: An AI Agent for Knowledge-Intensive Biomedical QA

live_model.evidence: Sec. 4.4: 'Among the baselines, GPT-4-Turbo achieves the highest accuracy at 65.0%, while LLaMA3.1-8B reaches 55.5%.' (AfriMed-QA expert multiple-choice)

prompt.location: Appendix E.1 'Prompt Template for Evaluating Baseline Models Under Multi-choice Reasoning Setting' (plain and CoT variants)

claim.metric: accuracy (%) on AfriMed-QA expert-level multiple-choice questions, pure LLM
claim.location: Sec. 4.4 text and Figure 6, 'Pure LLMs' bar for GPT-4-Turbo

data.source: AfriMed-QA (Olatunji et al., 2024; 15,275 items, expert MCQ subset) plus MMLU-Med, MedQA, PubMedQA, BioASQ

notes: Size of the expert MCQ subset is not stated in the text. The model is also the backbone of the KGARevion agent (69.6%), which needs the repo and knowledge graph. Paper 2024-10, no preview string, so alias resolved to the GA.

resolution.plan: n is unstated but defined: Sec. 4.5 evaluates 'all expert-level multiple-choice questions in AfriMed-QA', so take every expert-tier MCQ item in the public AfriMed-QA release (Olatunji et al., 2024). Prompt is the Appendix E.1 multiple-choice template (plain variant; run the CoT variant as a sensitivity check since Figure 6 does not say which was used), parse the option letter, and compare accuracy with 65.0%.
resolution.approximation: Item count comes from the public release (likely several thousand, so cost may exceed the mid tier); plain-vs-CoT variant not stated; template names options A-D while some AfriMed-QA items have five options.
